subtitle: Chipotle shredded chicken
verso: Tinga on a tostada, and the party's all set!
story: Tinga is from Puebla: lots of soft onion, tomato and smoky chipotle. It goes on tostadas with beans, crema and queso, and it's what you bring to a fiesta. Tostadas de tinga are on nearly every table at the Noche Mexicana on September 15, next to the pozole.

ingredients.title: The chicken
items: ¼ onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 bay leaf and salt, for poaching

ingredients.title: The sauce
items: 2–4 chipotles en adobo, plus 1 tbsp of the adobo sauce

steps: Simmer the chicken in water with the onion, garlic, bay leaf and salt for 20 minutes. Cool, shred and save [[1 cup]] of the broth.
Blend the tomatoes with the chipotles and adobo sauce.
Heat the lard and cook the sliced onions over medium-low 8 minutes, until soft and translucent but not brown. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomato-chipotle purée, oregano and bay leaves. Cook 8 minutes, until it darkens.
Add the chicken and [[½ cup]] of the broth. Simmer 10 minutes until juicy but not soupy. Season.
Spread tostadas with beans, pile on the tinga, and top with lettuce, crema, queso and avocado.

pressureCooker.time: 10 min high pressure + 5 min natural release
steps: On Sauté, soften the onions in the lard, then add the garlic.
Add the purée, oregano, bay leaves and ½ cup water. Nestle in the raw chicken thighs.
High pressure 10 minutes (8 for breasts), natural release 5.
Shred the chicken right in the sauce. Simmer on Sauté a few minutes to thicken.

tips: Be generous with the onion. Tinga should be half onion.
Start with 2 chipotles and add more after tasting. The heat varies from can to can.

variations.name: Tinga Poblana de Puerco
variations.subtitle: Pork and chorizo tinga
variations.note: The oldest printed tingas (La cocinera poblana, 1881) are pork with chorizo and longaniza, sometimes with potato.

items: 2 lb pork shoulder, cooked and shredded
The same tinga sauce as the base

steps: Fry the chorizo until it releases its fat. Add the onions and cook until soft.
Add the tomato-chipotle purée and cook 8 minutes, then add the pork and potato.
Simmer 10 minutes. Serve on tostadas with avocado.
variations.pressureNote: Cook the pork shoulder chunks at high pressure 35 minutes, natural release 10, then shred.
